ai_summary: Aastha Spintex Limited has announced a 1:1 bonus issue of equity shares, establishing September 28, 2026, as the record date, with the new shares becoming available for trading on September 30, 2026. This action will double the number of outstanding shares, theoretically halving the per-share price while maintaining the overall value of an investor's holding post-bonus. This is a standard corporate action that typically aims to improve liquidity and signals confidence, with no immediate red flags identified in the announcement.
